उन्मज्ज् उन्-मज्ज् (उद्-म्˚), cl. 6. P. -मज्जति,
-मङ्क्तुम्, to emerge: Caus. -मज्जयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to emerge.
उन्-मज्जन, अस्, m., N. of an attendant of Śiva.
उन्-मज्जन; add — (अम्), n. the act of emerging.
उन्मत्त उन्-मत्त. See उन्-मद् next col.

उन्-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, insane, frantic, mad; drunk,
intoxicated; (अस्), m. the thorn-apple, Datura Metel
and Fastuosa; another tree, Pterospermum Aceri-
folium; N. of a Rakṣas.
—उन्मत्त-कीर्ति, इस्, m.
an epithet of Śiva.
—उन्मत्त-गङ्ग, अम्, n., N. of
a region (‘where the Gaṅgā roars’).
—उन्मत्त-ता,
f. or उन्मत्त-त्व, अम्, n. insanity, intoxication.
—उन्मत्त-दर्शन or उन्मत्त-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्,
maniac-like, mad.
—उन्मत्त-प्रलपित, अस्, आ, अम्,
spoken in drunkenness or madness.
—उन्मत्त-भै-
रव-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra.
—उन्मत्त-
लिङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, feigning madness.
—उन्मत्त-वत्,
ind. like one mad, as if mad, like a maniac.
—उन्-
मत्त-वेश, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
—उन्मत्ता-
वन्ति (˚त-अव्˚), इस्, m., N. of a prince.

उन्मथ् उन्-मथ् or उन्-मन्थ् (उद्-म्˚), cl. 1.
9. P. -मथति or -मन्थति, -मथ्नाति, -मन्थि-
तुम्, to shake up, disturb, excite; to shake, tear, or
cut off; to strike, kill.

उन्-मथन, अम्, n. shaking off, throwing off or
down, slaughter.
उन्-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, agitated.

उन्-मन्थ, अस्, m. agitation; killing, slaughter;
a disease of the outer ear.

उन्-मन्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking up or off,
agitating, stirring; throbbing, beating; (अस्), m. in-
flammation of the outer ear.

उन्-मन्थन, अम्, n. the act of shaking or agi-
tating; hurting, killing; probing, stirring a weapon
&c. lodged in the body.

उन्-मन्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken up, moved,
agitated, distressed.

उन्-माथ, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying, killing; (अस्),
m. shaking; killing, slaughter; a snare or trap.
उन्-माथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shaking, agitating.

उन्मद् उन्-मद् (उद्-म्˚), cl. 4. P. -माद्यति,
-मदितुम्, to be or become mad: Caus. P. -मद-
यति or -मादयति, -यितुम्, to madden, inebriate,
render drunk.
उन्मत्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, insane, mad; drunk.

उन्-मद, अस्, आ, अम्, mad, furious, extravagant;
drunk, intoxicated; (अस्), m. insanity, either morbid
or as the effect of temporary excitement, intoxication,
ecstacy.

उन्-माद, अस्, आ, अम्, mad, insane, extravagant;
(अस्), m. madness, extravagance; (in medicine) mania.
—उन्माद-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, mad, insane, wild, ex-
travagant.
उन्-मदन, अस्, आ, अम्, inflamed with love.

उन्-मादन, अस्, आ, अम्, maddening, exciting, in-
toxicating; (अस्), m. one of the five arrows of the
god of love.

उन्-मदिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, mad, insane, crazed, in-
toxicated; in rut (as an elephant).

उन्मादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, mad, intoxicated; (नी), f., N.
of a princess.
उन्-मादुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fond of drinking.

उन्मनस् उन्-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or उन्-मनस्क
(उद्-म˚), अस्, आ, अम्, excited or disturbed in mind,
perplexed, disturbed; regretting, missing, repining for
a lost or departed friend.

उन्मनाय, nom. A. उन्मनायते, -यितुम्, to
become excited or disturbed in mind, to repine.

उन्मनी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make
excited, to excite, disturb.

उन्मनी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्, to be-
come disturbed in mind, to repine.

उन्मयूख उन्-मयूख (उद्-म्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
shining, radiant.

उन्मर्दन उन्-मर्दन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. मृद्
with उद्), rubbing off, rubbing; a fragrant essence
used for this purpose.

उन्मा उन्-मा, f. (fr. rt. मा with उद्), Ved. a
measure.

उन्-मान, अम्, n. a measure of size or quantity;
price.
उन्-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, meted, measured.
उन्-मिति, इस्, f. measure, price.

उन्-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be weighed, what is
weighed; (अम्), n. weight.

उन्मार्ग उन्-मार्ग (उद्-म्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n.
[]
a wrong road, deviation from the right way, improper
conduct, an evil course, error.
—उन्मार्ग-गत, अस्,
आ, अम्, erred, erring, going wrong.
—उन्मार्ग-
गमन, अम्, n. going on a wrong road, following
evil courses.
—उन्मार्ग-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or उन्-
मार्ग-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going wrong, erring, follow-
ing evil courses; taking a wrong road.
—उन्मार्ग-
जल-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, carrying its waters on a wrong
way.
उन्मार्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going astray, finding an outlet.
उन्मार्जन उन्-मार्जन. See उन्-मृज् below.
उन्-मार्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbing or wiping off.

उन्मिश्र उन्-मिश्र (उद्-म्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mixed
with, variegated.

उन्मिष् उन्-मिष् (उद्-मिष्), cl. 6. P. -मिषति,
-मेषितुम्, to open the eyes.
उन्-मिष, अस्, m. opening the eyes.

उन्-मिषत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, opening the eyes,
drawing up the eyelids, looking at, seeing.

उन्-मिषित, अस्, आ, अम्, opened (as the eye);
blown as a flower.
उन्-मेषण, अम्, n. awaking, becoming visible.

उन्मील् उन्-मील् (उद्-मील्), cl. 1. P. -मीलति,
-लितुम्, to open the eyes; to open; to expand, be
diffused: Caus. P. -मीलयति, -यितुम्, to open.

उन्-मील, अस्, m. opening of the eyes, awaking,
becoming visible.

उन्-मीलन, अम्, n. winking, twinkling, opening
of the eye; awaking, becoming visible; blowing,
expanding.

उन्मुख उन्-मुख (उद्-म्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, raising
the face, looking at; waiting for, expecting; near to;
(अस्), m., N. of an antelope (in the Hari-vaṃśa, in
former births a hunter and a Brāhman).
—उन्मुख-
ता, f. the state of one whose face is raised; state of
watching or expectancy.

उन्मुखर उन्-मुखर (उद्-म्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
loud-sounding, noisy.

उन्मुच् उन्-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते,
-मोक्तुम्, to unfasten, pull off; take off (clothes &c.);
to loosen, liberate; to elevate, raise: Caus. P. -मोच-
यति, -यितुम्, to loosen, deliver.
उन्-मुच, अस्, m., N. of a man.
उन्-मोचन, अम्, n. unfastening, loosening.

उन्मुद्र उन्-मुद्र (उद्-म्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, un-
sealed, opened; blown as a flower.

उन्मूल उन्-मूल (उद्-म्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, eradi-
cated, pulled up by the root.

उन्-मूलन, अम्, n. eradicating, pulling up by the
roots; destroying.

उन्मूलय, nom. P. उन्मूलयति, -यितुम्, to era-
dicate, pull up by the roots; to extirpate, destroy.

उन्-मूलित, अस्, आ, अम्, eradicated, pulled up by
the roots; destroyed.

उन्मृजावमृजा (˚ज-अव्˚), f. repeatedly rubbing
up and down.

उन्-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, worn off, blotted out,
effaced.

उन्मृश्य उन्-मृश्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. मृश् with
उद्), Ved. to be reached, to be touched.

उन्मेदा उन्-मेदा, f. (fr. rt. मिद् with उद्),
corpulence, fatness.

उन्-मणि, इस्, m. a jewel found on the surface of
the ground (= बहिः-प्रकट).
